risks.risk: Brake condition may be poor (pads worn, cable stretched, or brake not gripping).
risks.proof: A short video of a safe stop test: ride slowly, squeeze both brakes, show the bike stopping quickly and straight; plus close-up of brake pads/cables.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes not confirmed (assume needs service/adjustment).

risks.risk: Gears may skip or not shift correctly (chain wear, derailleur misalignment).
risks.proof: Video showing shifting through all gears while pedaling, with the chain staying on the sprockets (no skipping).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gears not confirmed (assume may need adjustment/repair).

risks.risk: Hidden rust or corrosion on underside, chain area, or inside frame joints.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the chain, crank area, underside of the frame, and any weld points (plus a flashlight shot).

risks.risk: Wrong size/fit for the child (wheel size not shown clearly), affecting value.
risks.proof: Photo of the wheel size marking (e.g., 16/18/20 inch) or a tape-measure measurement of wheel diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest likely kids-bike value without confirmed size.

risks.risk: Missing or replaced parts (non-original brakes/seat/handlebar grips) reducing value.
risks.proof: Close-ups of key components (brake levers, shifters/derailleur, chain, seat clamp, pedals) showing any markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as parts may not be fully original.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the brake system (both sides) and shifter/gear mechanism.
Short video: shifting through all gears while pedaling + a clear brake stop test.
Close-ups of chain/crank/underside frame for rust/corrosion check.
Wheel size confirmation (marking photo or measured wheel diameter).
response.reason: The photo confirms it’s a kids bicycle, but the key value drivers the seller mentions (brakes/gears working, no rust, original parts, and wheel size) are not verifiable from this single wide shot. Request the specific close-ups and test videos before pricing.
